review: My church was outlawed in 1948 and legalised again in 1989 and in Texas there is no parish of it at all, so I attend a Roman Catholic church and I miss my own rite every single Sunday and nobody there knows there is anything to miss. "A Venit Pentru Cea Una" — he came for the one. I work paediatric nights and I play this in the corridor at three in the morning. My great-uncle was a Greek-Catholic priest who did eleven years in prison for refusing to convert and died before I was old enough to ask him anything. Five stars, and thank you for putting my language in a corridor in Dallas.
